def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # Find full-width horizontal dividers and full-height vertical dividers.
    divr = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == grid[r][0] and v != 0 for v in grid[r])]
    divc = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != 0 for r in range(h))]
    rb = [-1] + divr + [h]
    cb = [-1] + divc + [w]
    nr, nc = len(rb)-1, len(cb)-1

    panels = {}
    for i in range(nr):
        for j in range(nc):
            r0, r1 = rb[i]+1, rb[i+1]
            c0, c1 = cb[j]+1, cb[j+1]
            cells = [(r-r0, c-c0, grid[r][c])
                     for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)
                     if grid[r][c] != 0]
            panels[i, j] = (r0, r1, c0, c1, cells)

    # Reflect patterns across horizontal dividers, but only in columns
    # where that pattern is present on one side of the divider.
    for i in range(nr-1):
        for j in range(nc):
            a = panels[i, j]
            b = panels[i+1, j]
            if bool(a[4]) == bool(b[4]):
                continue
            src, dst = (a, b) if a[4] else (b, a)
            sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1, cells = src
            dr0, dr1, dc0, dc1, _ = dst
            if sr1-sr0 != dr1-dr0 or sc1-sc0 != dc1-dc0:
                continue
            ph, pw = sr1-sr0, sc1-sc0
            for y, x, color in cells:
                g[dr0 + ph-1-y][dc0+x] = color
    return g

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Locate uniformly colored divider lines.
    hr = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][0] != 0 and
          all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r])]
    vc = [c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != 0 and
          all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    rb, cb = [-1] + hr + [h], [-1] + vc + [w]
    R, C = len(rb) - 1, len(cb) - 1

    panels = {}
    for i in range(R):
        for j in range(C):
            r0, r1 = rb[i] + 1, rb[i + 1]
            c0, c1 = cb[j] + 1, cb[j + 1]
            cells = [(r-r0, c-c0, grid[r][c])
                     for r in range(r0, r1)
                     for c in range(c0, c1) if grid[r][c] != 0]
            panels[i, j] = (r0, r1, c0, c1, cells)

    # Copy a band's figures, reflected vertically, into the next band.
    # A blank destination panel is filled; occupied panels are preserved.
    for i in range(R - 1):
        for j in range(C):
            src = panels[i, j]
            dst = panels[i + 1, j]
            if not src[4] or dst[4]:
                continue
            r0, r1, c0, c1, cells = src
            dr0, dr1, dc0, dc1, _ = dst
            ph, pw = r1-r0, c1-c0
            if dr1-dr0 != ph or dc1-dc0 != pw:
                continue
            for y, x, color in cells:
                out[dr0 + ph - 1 - y][dc0 + x] = color

    return out
